question.text: When a listed entity approaches SEBI with a grievance against a proxy advisor, under which provisions does SEBI examine the matter for non-compliance with the Code of Conduct?

answer.text: Regulation 24(2) of SEBI (Research Analyst) Regulations, 2014 only
Regulation 4(2)(a) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 read with SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations
SEBI examines matters under Regulation 24(2) read with Regulation 23(1) of SEBI (Research Analyst) Regulations, 2014 and the procedural guidelines

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the Series III-A workbook (page 411), listed entities may approach SEBI with grievances against proxy advisors. SEBI examines such matters for non-compliance with the Code of Conduct under Regulation 24(2) read with Regulation 23(1) of the SEBI (Research Analyst) Regulations, 2014, together with the procedural guidelines. The Trap: Options that point to LODR provisions only address listed entity obligations and do not capture the regulatory standard under which SEBI examines proxy advisor conduct. Citing Regulation 24(2) alone is incomplete because the examination is read with Regulation 23(1) and the procedural guidelines. Note: The grievance route is "listed entity to SEBI", with SEBI then examining the proxy advisor's compliance under the Research Analyst Regulations and the procedural guidelines.
